subject.title: AGENTS.md/SKILL.md rules lack runtime enforcement; no session rollback; Stop button leaves zombie lock files

question: Should OpenClaw add arbitrary turn rollback beyond pre-compaction checkpoint restore, and should that contract restore transcript state only or attempt to coordinate reversible tool and filesystem effects?
rationale: Current main supports only compaction-based checkpoints, while general last-N-turn rollback changes persistent session semantics and cannot safely promise reversal of already-executed external effects without explicit product direction.

options.title: Transcript-Only Rollback
options.body: Add a clearly labeled branch-or-restore operation for selected transcript turns while warning that completed external side effects are not undone.

options.title: Full Checkpoint System
options.body: Design coordinated transcript and reversible-operation checkpoints before exposing rollback as a general recovery feature.

options.title: Keep Compaction Checkpoints
options.body: Retain pre-compaction restore as the only supported rollback boundary and use branching or reset for other recovery cases.

recommendation.title: Transcript-Only Rollback
recommendation.body: Add a clearly labeled branch-or-restore operation for selected transcript turns while warning that completed external side effects are not undone.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current session-lifecycle contributor in the available history and already own the adjacent Stop recovery path.
